subject: HTML5: suppress uploading graphs to imgur

messages.author: 46b63db5e5ff7d37
messages.subject: HTML5: suppress uploading graphs to imgur
parts:
Dear lists,
I have two question here:
1. When I tried to make the HTML5 slides with knitr, I found by
default the generated graphs are uploaded to http://imgur.com/, but I
don't want to do that, I'd rather to use the local graphs in my
working process OR upload the graphs to my imgur account, how can I
realize it?

2. Another problem is my figures don't display well (even I changed
the height of the figure to a smaller value), like this:
[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/sVpRq.png[/IMG]
and I want the caption to be centered at the bottom of the figure.
One way I found to solve this problem is to add a <center> tag like
this:
<center> ![My caption](/figure/myfigure.png) </center>
but the caption will disappear, I have to add the caption manually.

Does anyone know how to solve my problems?
Thanks in advance: )

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] HTML5: suppress uploading graphs to imgur
parts:
1. Do not set opts_knit$set(upload.fun = imgur_upload) so the images
will not be uploaded;

2. That is a CSS problem; you will have to tweak the CSS definitions
of the DZslides template of pandoc, e.g. for the figures to be
centered, you may use something like

figure {
text-align: center;
}

Regards,
Yihui
